fusions.name: Long-Awaited Swing
fusions.desc: After a 1.5-second wind-up, swings in a full circle, dealing 34 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Dragging Chop
fusions.desc: A heavy chop that deals 8 damage, leaves the target [Slowed] for 3 seconds and 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up.

fusions.name: Slow Wind-Up
fusions.desc: After a 2-second wind-up, increases your damage by 40% for 20 seconds.

fusions.name: In Its Own Time
fusions.desc: After 10 seconds without a critical hit, your crit chance rises by 50% for your next strike. Once every 10 seconds.
